title: Lether
summary: LETH'ER, noun 1. The skin of an animal dressed and prepared for use. 2. Dressed hides in general. 3. Skin; in an ironical sense. LEATH'ER, LETH'ER, adjective Lethern; consisting of leather; as a leath

inlines.v: LETH'ER, noun 1. The skin of an animal dressed and prepared for use. 2. Dressed hides in general. 3. Skin; in an ironical sense. LEATH'ER, LETH'ER, adjective Lethern; consisting of leather; as a leather glove.
